unique meta title and description per page

high dwell time (time on page > 2 minutes)
scroll depth (users reading past the fold)

page load under 1 second for 2.5-5x more conversions vs 5-10 second load
social proof visible within first screen
no more than one primary action competing for attention

three_click_path_definition.click_3: Add to cart (with express checkout option for 1-click purchase)

conversion_benchmarks.page_speed_impact: 1-second load = 2.5-5x more conversions vs 5-10 second load

delivery promise / shipping speed prominently displayed

Medium priority: product categories — moderate bid
Low priority: full catalogue catch-all — conservative bid
product_feed_tips: Include brand name + key specs in product title (boosts CTR by 18%)
Optimised descriptions improve quality score by 10%
Better quality score reduces CPC by up to 15%
High-quality images are the single biggest lever in Shopping

Google Ads account linked to Merchant Center

Retargeting (visitors who viewed product but didn't buy)

above_fold_must_haves: Emotional hook — not a product, a feeling or transformation
Single primary CTA (Shop Now / Explore Collection)
Delivery trust signal (e.g. 'Free UK delivery over £30')
One trust badge or social proof signal
Brand tagline that answers: why Salty Lamps over anyone else?
below_fold_journey: Section 2: Featured / bestselling products (3-4 products, quick-add)
Section 3: Health benefits strip (animated icons, emotional copy)
Section 4: Brand story teaser (manufacturer, from Himalayas to your home)
Section 5: Customer reviews carousel (5-star social proof)
Section 6: B2B callout (for spas/butchers/equestrian — drives to trade portal)
Section 7: Instagram / UGC feed (real people using products)
Section 8: Newsletter (lead magnet — free Salt Care Guide)
engagement_tactics: Autoplay ambient video (muted, looping, 15-30s — lamp glowing in dark room)
Animated number counters (e.g. '5,000+ happy customers', '10+ years manufacturing')
Hover state on products (image swap to product-in-use lifestyle shot)
Bundle offer badges (visible immediately on product cards)
copywriting_principles: Lead with transformation, not features: 'Transform any room into a sanctuary' not 'Buy a salt lamp'
Use sensory language: glow, warmth, calm, breathe, amber light
Answer the intent: browsing (show collections), buying (show price + offer), gifting (show gift sets)
Build urgency without fake scarcity: seasonal offers, limited bundles
Speak to values: natural, handcrafted, direct from the Himalayas, UK-based
